text_block_list.text:
Today, Кинг Хало and I are going to a
fashion show for the latest
signature
racewear.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: We agreed to meet up at 9 a.m., but...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: You're late! What time do you think it is?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
If I say 9 a.m., then I mean 8 a.m.! Gosh,
how could you keep me
waiting for a
whole hour?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Making me, a first-rate Umamusume, stand
alone at the back of the
line...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
As your punishment, you'll have to treat
me to some tea before we
head back.
Hmph, be grateful that I'm letting you off
the hook this
time!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Please, I'm practically being magnanimous.
Anyway, enough with the
chitchat—hurry
up and get in line!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Кинг Хало pulls me into the line.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
There are so many people here that it
might be hard to see the stage.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list: It seems like it's a pretty popular show.

text_block_list.text:
Of course it's popular... Perhaps you don't
fully comprehend the
significance of
today's event, so let me enlighten you.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Today, only the finest brands will be
shown. We'll see the best outfits
from the
best designers! Truly a first-rate
experience!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
The show's going to be so good that you
won't even want to blink.
Don't even think
about looking away for a second!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Especially when it comes to...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Кинг Хало's eyes sparkle with excitement
as she rattles off every
aspect of the
fashion show.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: One hour later...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It's almost time for the show to start, but
we've barely moved
forward... I can't see
anything from here...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I hope they didn't make us wait all this
time just to tell us that they've
already
reached max capacity...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Why on earth would I do that? Today's
show is—
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Excuse me, are you Кинг Хало?
text_block_list.name: Show Staff

text_block_list.text: Ah... yes, that's right. Who might you be?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Aha, I had a feeling. I'm part of the event
operations team. I wanted
to say that it's
been an honor to work with your mother
on the show—
text_block_list.name: Show Staff

text_block_list.text: Ah, I see.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I'm well aware that my mother's designs
are the main event and will be
showcased
as the grand finale.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
So you're interested in her work as well?
Of course, you're her
daughter after all.
I've heard from your mother that you've
been
fantastic at Tracen—
text_block_list.name: Show Staff

text_block_list.text: Are you sure that's what you heard?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Please, spare me the platitudes. I know well what she would say, and especially what she wouldn't. Like you said, I am her daughter.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Oh, my apologies... Well, if you'll excuse
me then...
text_block_list.name: Show Staff

text_block_list.text:
I guess he was one of my mother's
acquaintances.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Hm, it looks like you've got something to
say. Well, don't make me
wait—just get it
out already.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list: I didn't know your mother was part of this show.

text_block_list.text:
After my mother retired from racing, she
became a professional
designer for
signature racewear.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
It pains me to say this, but she truly
embodies "first-rate". She
surpasses
everyone's expectations with each and
every dress she
makes.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Her designs are timeless, crafted with
perfection for all racers. There's
a lot to be
learned from her work.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
...Well, I suppose not all racers. She never
made anything for me.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
It doesn't matter though. Her talent in
design didn't carry over into
sewing.
Honestly, she's terribly clumsy.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Despite her own shortcomings, she's
always been overly competitive
and vain.
She's loath to show even her own daughter
something less
than perfect.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I remember how she bought a birthday
cake for me, watched me eat
it, then hid in
another room to eat her own failed
creation.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
It's ridiculous. I wish she'd just
acknowledge her weaknesses and
failures.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Not at all!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Everyone, thank you for waiting! We'll now
begin guiding you all to
the event hall!
text_block_list.name: Staff Member

text_block_list.text: It's about time. Come on, let's get going.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
...They better show some excellent
dresses. Otherwise, I won't forgive
them
for making me wait so long.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
And that concludes today's event. Thank
you for coming. Please
return home safely.
text_block_list.name: Event Announcer

text_block_list.text:
That... was... amazing! Did you see the new
designs by UMADA? Oh
my gosh, I love
how they designed the switching skirt!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: But the prettiest one was definitely—
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: ...Never mind!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Hmph. Just you wait and see. I'm going to
surpass my mother's race
record in no time.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
And I won't just have one signature
racewear—I'm going to have a
whole closet
full of them!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Because I'm a first-rate racer—the one and
only Кинг Хало!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list: Yes you are. Let's give it our all!

text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! I'm glad you're on the same
page as me! Excellent! ♪
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Let's head back to the academy now.
We've got lots of planning to
do for
tomorrow's training schedule!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
As Кинг Хало walks away from the event
hall, her face shines with
ever-increasing
determination.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
